name: Nested menus help
description: Help mode entries for the Nested menus plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Generated menu bar
entries.text: Every page, dialog, setting and action, filed by category: Start, Work, Builds, AI & agents, Plugins, Framework, Look & layout, Apps, System, Account, Help. At most 12 rows per level; the rest sits in sub menus. Start holds Favourites, Recent and Jump to…. Right-click the bar for Menu settings or to go back to the shared menus.

entries.title: Generated navigation
entries.text: Favourites and recently opened pages first, then one row per category that slides open. Right-click a page to pin it to Favourites.

entries.title: Jump to…
entries.text: Type a word from a page, plugin, setting or action and press Enter to open the first match. Ctrl+Shift+K opens it anywhere.

entries.title: Generated nested menus
entries.text: On: the generated menus replace the shared app-menu and nav-menu assets for this app. Off: the shared menus come back. The generated ones stay registered as assets either way.

entries.title: Pin to Favourites
entries.text: Pins (or unpins) the current page in the Favourites list at the top of the menus. Favourites rank first in Jump to… too.

entries.title: Regenerate
entries.text: Reads the registry again and rebuilds the menus. Normally not needed: a plugin installed or a page added regenerates them by itself.

entries.title: Menu settings
entries.text: General (override, rows per level, grouping, navigation style), Categories (switch any off), Favourites, Recent (how many are kept) and a Preview of the tree. Every setting is also a command: menus.set <field> <value>.
